test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bf42783fe08317c3ef731221cdf990003072d99b9b95355e706b4c3b839210e.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**(Product of left and right side numbers) ÷ (Product of upper and lower numbers) = Middle Number.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bf42783fe08317c3ef731221cdf990003072d99b9b95355e706b4c3b839210e.png] 

 

For the first figure,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d37ff059feae8b5102563bc6870e48f745e2d7d0977244d77b2991b456c349a7.png] ⇒ (6 × 4) ÷ (2 × 3) = 24 ÷ 6 = 4

For the second figure,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdc8696fba84ef9db3e3c7bee76a0d0fa70f20ef98fb7f6a0b80e7ae8299bb23.png] ⇒ (6 × 3) ÷ (1 × 3) = 18 ÷ 3 = 6

Similarly, for the third figure,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/590bf47c66f1dec1a632c5b0cce22fbb982f56f6a87e9c475242af5c13940183.png] ⇒ (10 × 4) ÷ (2 × 5) = 40 ÷ 10 = 4

So, 4 will come in the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer is **"4"**.
